currency_assumptions: Costs retain their published local amount and ISO code: HKD where the venue publishes HKD (Banyan Workspace HK$888/hr, Garage Society HKD 3,000/hr, the Hive Wan Chai HK$2,500/hr and HK$1,250/hr).

HKD-to-USD conversion: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates, retrieved 2026-08-10 (ECB daily feed, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml): EUR 1 = USD 1.1555 and EUR 1 = HKD 9.0653, therefore USD 1 = HKD 7.845348 (computed 9.0653 / 1.1555) and 1 HKD = USD 0.1274640663. This is a documented, date-stamped source rate; it is a planning conversion, not a bank/venue quote.

All USD estimates are derived 8-hour calculations labeled in evidence.inference and rate_estimate_note; +taxes/fees and any AV add-ons are preserved as verification questions where the page does not show them included.

Good Lab's published '$900-$1,200' hourly figures carry no HKD marker and the page's Webflow currency setting declares USD; per the Run A currency rule the HKD amount is not page-visible, so its cost stays null with a confirm-currency question instead of an assumed conversion.
The Wave homepage advertises an event-space Flash Sale 'From $1,200/Hour' without a currency marker; the official event-space page is quote-based, so cost stays null with a confirm-cost question.
